fields.headline: CRISIS LINE SWAMPED AFTER BUS CRASH
fields.lowerThird: 400 calls about crash since noon; callers told to dial 911
fields.ticker: State Patrol: county road near Ellery Ridge remains closed while the investigation continues • Families gathering at Ellery Ridge High School gym from 6 p.m. tonight • Community vigil planned Friday 7 p.m. at Ellery Ridge High School • Ellery Ridge Consolidated Schools: classes canceled Friday • Tonight: cloudy, low 31°, northwest wind 5–10 mph
fields.anchorBrief: Field reporter with a microphone outside a small-town Nebraska high school at dusk under an overcast sky, parked pickups and a few people standing near the gym doors, broadcast camera footage, no visible faces of grieving people

instructorNote: Show the still, then read the NEMA flyer email and the state coordinator's call from the MSEL row out loud. This inject tests whether COM corrects the chyron once, in writing and without numbers taken out of context, with ED as the only spokesperson. COM should also ask for the flyer to be fixed: no in-person deployment, the disaster behavioral health team runs the vigil, and the help line block carries the 988 call, text and chat wording marked EXERCISE. Watch that DCO reviews the final status, the partner message and the staff update for safe messaging before ED signs them off.

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Press photograph, level horizon, 35 mm lens, sharp, natural daylight color. Broadcast news camera frame of a female field reporter in a dark wool coat holding a handheld microphone, standing on the edge of a parking lot outside a small-town Nebraska high school at dusk, late autumn. Behind her is a low tan brick gymnasium with plain double steel doors and warm light spilling from small windows. A few parked pickup trucks sit on the lot, and a handful of adults in winter jackets stand in small groups near the gym doors, seen from behind and far away. Heavy overcast grey sky, bare trees, flat prairie on the horizon, cold blue evening light mixed with a soft camera-mounted key light on the reporter. Level 35 mm framing, sharp, sober mood. Setting: a school parking lot with a line of cars and parents standing behind a folding table with signs, volunteers in vests, a bus at the curb, overcast sky
